text: This week, Carlos Dieter Ewing's activity triggered a detection rule for unusual volume of attachment data sent to external recipients. The evidence suggests that he sent 57.08 MB of email attachments, which is significantly above his typical range of 9.49 MB and exceeds the maximum of 50.06 MB. This is also higher than what same-role peers typically send this week (6.96 MB). Additionally, Carlos sent attachments to an unusually high number of external recipients, with 33 being the total count. This is beyond the normal range for him (15) and even higher than his peers' typical count (13).
